meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让系统自动跑实验,持续优化代码与模型效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你总在反复调参做实验,希望系统自动帮你找到更好的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run iterative experiments to keep improving your code and model results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of manually tweaking models and want the system to find the best approach for you

howto.what: Claude 会把一个现有作品(代码、训练配置、提示词等)当作改进对象,以你设定的目标和评分命令为准,自动反复做实验。它会记录每个假设的成败,只有通过独立测试评估的版本才会被选为最佳,最后给你实验报告。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个可修改的工件(如模型、agent 框架、数据管道)做多轮实验改进并给出可评分的目标时触发;也会在你描述反复「实验-评估」循环、担忧开发/测试差距时自动接管。

say.text: 把这份训练脚本的 dev 损失降下来,用测试集做最终验收,别过拟合。
say.note: 会进入自主优化,先确认目标和评估器。

say.text: 改进我的 agent 框架,跑 10 轮实验,保留通过测试的最好版本。
say.note: 会初始化假设树并按预算循环。

say.text: 这个 Kaggle 式任务,帮我搜多组方案,只保留测试集表现好的。
say.note: 会并行探索并执行测试合并门。

howto.what_en: Claude autonomously improves an artifact (code, config, prompt) against your objective and evaluator, records hypotheses in a tree, and promotes only changes that pass a held-out test evaluator.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want multi-round improvement of an artifact under an evaluator, or when you describe repeated experiment-evaluate loops and worry about a dev/test gap.

say_en.text: Improve this script's dev loss; accept only on a test split, don't overfit.
say_en.note: Starts the optimization loop after confirming metrics.

say_en.text: Improve my agent with 10 experiment cycles, keep the best test-passing version.
say_en.note: Initializes a hypothesis tree and runs within budget.

say_en.text: For this Kaggle task, search approaches; keep the test-best one.
say_en.note: Explores in parallel and applies the test merge gate.
